answer: Voting credentials use a capped proof-of-service auction. Each applicant burns 28 credits, locks 95 for 30 epochs, and accepts three random delivery jobs over eight days. A lantern beacon selects jobs; a garden accumulator emits one-use completion nullifiers, and an atlas registry binds each trace to one key and payout source. Five of seven established auditors replay the traces before activation. Extra identities need separate burns, capital, live service, and new quorums; copied or missed jobs slash 70%, while bids, traces, nullifiers, and penalties are public.
